title: Arbitrage Bot | Software for arbitration of cryptocurrencies
description: Read more about the bot in Telegram - https://t.me/+-doadrsitza2ztli  Arbitrage Bot is a software from the Spread Maker team for arbitration of cryptocurrencies. Software in automatic mode monitors changes in courses on different exchanges and gives you a ready -made bunch with a certain percentage of spread. He collects information from all top exchanges, providing 24/7 ligaments. The bot, relying on the glass, shows how much you can really go into the deal, considers the cost of transferring a coin on a particular network to another exchange, and also shows whether the entry and withdrawal on exchanges is open at a given time. Everything is packed in the form of Telegram the bot, which allows you to trade even from the phone, anywhere where you were! Software has many filters for setting up for each user so that your work is as effective as possible.  #arbitration clips #cryptoarbitrazh #cryptocurrency #intercarrhage Arbitration #mark #Software

asr.full_text: YET NEVER has earnings on crypto-currency not been so simple and durable. This is a safe strategy! Its essence is buying crypto currency on one exchange is cheaper and subsequent sale of the same crypto currency to another exchange more expensive at the same time. It is almost impossible to find data hands-on. Therefore we developed a product which does it for you. Arbitrage Bot is a software of Spreadmaker for arbitrage of cryptocurrencies. Software automatically monitors exchange rate change in different exchanges and gives you a score with certain spread percentage. It collects information from all top exchanges, providing 24 to 7 links. a few of their services and is also available for free for those who want to buy only on a custom-built phone. The device can also be purchased with the support of the app. It is also available in a 2% discount where the user and your other users can purchase the device from a discount of $ 100, and the price will be different for each application. The price of the device is also higher that other Internet sites, but the application is also offered for free, so it is possible to purchase the device. The whole package is in the form of a Telegram bot, which allows you to trade even from your phone, anywhere, wherever you are, adjust the software individually by your criteria, using filters so that your work is as efficient as possible. Profit Filter Add a minimum profit amount and track the signals only above the above value. Spread Percentage Filter of the above value. Spread % filter Point at the percentage that interests you and the Bot will show the bonds of the above spread. Volume Filter Trade using your bank for the most. Point out the required volume of the transaction relying on your capital. Hedge Check the chance to hedge your transaction, will provide you with the maximum reliability for you. Forex. Get signals only from the desired sites, turning off or disabling information collection from specific exchanges. Displayed coins. If you have specific tokens, then enter a coin ticker and the bot will send you signals only on this cryptocurrency. Black list. Distribute tokens you do not want to trade for any reason. Money in liquidity. Is the questionable money not for you? You can choose coins from the Top 100, 200, 300 and so on according to the Coinmarketcap version. Combine filters to improve your results. Arbitrage Bot is the ready product that generates real profits. You can get more information in our Telegram channel link in the description under the video.
